correctness.rationale: A complete factor-elimination computation uses exact min-cost/tie-count arithmetic and no pruning to enumerate occupancy sector minima on GP(10,2). An independently coded reflected-ternary traversal enumerated exactly 3,486,784,401 assignments and agreed on all 21 sector minima/multiplicities. The strict lower-hull inequalities and collinear (14,16,18,20) sectors at D/J=1/2 imply the three-branch energy and stated counts for all real D/J. At D/J=15/14 only Q=0,14 tie.

value.rationale: A canonical twenty-site frustrated fullerene graph and the standard crystal-field vacancy model give a natural occupation invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Exact nontrivial consequences are a stable six-vacancy occupancy plateau, a four-sector degeneracy enhancement 1280 at the first transition, and a second transition from Q=14 to the vacuum. These values are useful finite-cluster baselines and are not determined by the prior Q=20 Ising enumeration. Value is limited to a finite idealized cluster.
